title: SpaceX Just Launched 27 More Starlink Satellites — Falcon 9’s 17th Flight!
speaker: The Dark Hour Finance
zh: 【The Dark Hour Finance】SpaceX 剛剛發射了另外 27 顆星鏈衛星——獵鷹 9 號的第 17 次飛行！（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: SpaceX has just added another batch of satellites to its massive Starlink network, and this
cues.en: SpaceX has just added another batch of satellites to its massive Starlink network, and this
cues.zh: SpaceX 剛剛在其龐大的 Starlink 網路中新增了另一批衛星，這

cues.text: launch shows just how quickly the company is scaling up its operations.
cues.en: launch shows just how quickly the company is scaling up its operations.
cues.zh: 發布表明該公司擴大業務規模的速度有多快。

cues.text: A Falcon 9 rocket carrying 27 Starlink satellites lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base
cues.en: A Falcon 9 rocket carrying 27 Starlink satellites lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base
cues.zh: 搭載 27 顆星鏈衛星的獵鷹 9 號火箭從范登堡太空部隊基地升空

cues.text: in California at 9.47 p.m. Eastern Time on Saturday.
cues.en: in California at 9.47 p.m. Eastern Time on Saturday.
cues.zh: 晚上 9 點 47 分在加州東部時間週六。

cues.text: And as expected, the launch went smoothly.
cues.en: And as expected, the launch went smoothly.
cues.zh: 正如預期的那樣，發布進行得很順利。

cues.text: About eight and a half minutes after liftoff, the Falcon 9's first stage booster returned
cues.en: About eight and a half minutes after liftoff, the Falcon 9's first stage booster returned
cues.zh: 升空後約八分半鐘，獵鷹 9 號第一級助推器返回

cues.text: to Earth, landing on SpaceX's drone ship, Of Course I Still Love You, waiting in the
cues.en: to Earth, landing on SpaceX's drone ship, Of Course I Still Love You, waiting in the
cues.zh: 飛往地球，降落在 SpaceX 的無人機船上，當然我仍然愛你，在太空中等待

cues.text: Pacific Ocean.
cues.en: Pacific Ocean.
cues.zh: 太平洋。

cues.text: What makes this booster even more impressive is that it wasn't flying for the first time.
cues.en: What makes this booster even more impressive is that it wasn't flying for the first time.
cues.zh: 這個助推器更令人印象深刻的是它並不是第一次飛行。

cues.text: This particular booster, known as 1093, has now completed its 17th mission.
cues.en: This particular booster, known as 1093, has now completed its 17th mission.
cues.zh: 這個被稱為 1093 的特殊助推器現已完成其第 17 次任務。

cues.text: Meanwhile, the Falcon 9's upper stage continued toward low Earth orbit, carrying all 27
cues.en: Meanwhile, the Falcon 9's upper stage continued toward low Earth orbit, carrying all 27
cues.zh: 同時，獵鷹 9 號的上級繼續飛向近地軌道，載著全部 27 名太空人。

cues.text: Starlink satellites.
cues.en: Starlink satellites.
cues.zh: 星鏈衛星。

cues.text: Around 62 minutes after launch, the satellites were deployed as planned.
cues.en: Around 62 minutes after launch, the satellites were deployed as planned.
cues.zh: 發射後約 62 分鐘，衛星按計畫部署。

cues.text: And this is where the scale of Starlink becomes pretty remarkable.
cues.en: And this is where the scale of Starlink becomes pretty remarkable.
cues.zh: 這就是星鏈規模變得非常引人注目的地方。

cues.text: According to satellite tracker Jonathan McDowell, the Starlink constellation now has more than
cues.en: According to satellite tracker Jonathan McDowell, the Starlink constellation now has more than
cues.zh: 根據衛星追蹤器喬納森·麥克道爾的說法，星鏈星座現在擁有超過

cues.text: 11,100 active spacecraft orbiting Earth.
cues.en: 11,100 active spacecraft orbiting Earth.
cues.zh: 11,100 艘活躍太空船繞地球執行。

cues.text: Saturday's mission was SpaceX's 107th Falcon 9 launch of 2026, with 81 of those
cues.en: Saturday's mission was SpaceX's 107th Falcon 9 launch of 2026, with 81 of those
cues.zh: 週六的任務是 SpaceX 2026 年第 107 次獵鷹 9 號發射，其中 81 次

cues.text: missions dedicated to expanding Starlink.
cues.en: missions dedicated to expanding Starlink.
cues.zh: 致力於擴充套件星鏈的任務。

cues.text: But SpaceX actually launched even more frequently last year.
cues.en: But SpaceX actually launched even more frequently last year.
cues.zh: 但 SpaceX 去年的發射其實更頻繁。

cues.text: In 2025, Falcon 9 flew 165 times, including 122 Starlink missions.
cues.en: In 2025, Falcon 9 flew 165 times, including 122 Starlink missions.
cues.zh: 2025年，獵鷹9號飛行了165次，其中包括122次星鏈任務。

cues.text: If SpaceX continues at its current pace, 2026 could end with around 149 Falcon 9
cues.en: If SpaceX continues at its current pace, 2026 could end with around 149 Falcon 9
cues.zh: 如果 SpaceX 繼續保持目前的速度，到 2026 年可能會擁有約 149 架獵鷹 9 號火箭

cues.text: launches, including roughly 113 Starlink missions.
cues.en: launches, including roughly 113 Starlink missions.
cues.zh: 發射，包括大約 113 次星鏈任務。

cues.text: For SpaceX, this isn't just another launch, it's another step in turning rocket reusability
cues.en: For SpaceX, this isn't just another launch, it's another step in turning rocket reusability
cues.zh: 對 SpaceX 來說，這不僅是另一次發射，更是提高火箭可重複使用性的另一步

cues.text: and high-frequency launches into something that increasingly looks routine.
cues.en: and high-frequency launches into something that increasingly looks routine.
cues.zh: 以及高頻地推出一些看起來越來越例行公事的事情。
